jobs.description: Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year. Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost. We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, an Execution Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network. You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team. The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner. Key job responsibilities - Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements - Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels - Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain - Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience - Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity - Provide analytical deep dives and models to better guide network execution and strategy About the team Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably. The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock. Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Our work spans research and engineering, with a strong focus on translating advances in AI into scalable systems and real-world impact. You will design and build scalable data pipelines, improve human data labeling workflows, create synthetic datasets, and develop automated approaches for continuously measuring and improving dataset quality. This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of machine learning engineering and data engineering. Proficiency in designing human-in-the-loop labeling systems and proactively mitigating complex dataset failure modes such as label noise, bias, contamination, and distribution shift. Demonstrated success using LLMs for data generation, model-assisted labeling, and evaluation, with a focus on connecting iterative dataset changes to measurable improvements in model performance. Strong technical foundation in distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Ray, Beam) and the ability to architect and deploy complex data engineering projects into production. A research-engineering mindset that bridges the gap between experimentation and production, combined with communication skills to influence researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders. We are seeking a Program Manager III to lead expansion strategy for our Rural Super Rural Plus (RSR+) program within R2L. In this role, you will own strategic expansion planning end-to-end — evaluating and prioritizing opportunities, building the roadmaps that guide the program's long-term growth, and driving expansion initiatives from intake through execution within a defined program lifecycle. This position requires a self-directed operator who can navigate ambiguity with autonomy, deep dive across a wide range of functional domains, and communicate with impact at every level — up to VP-level leadership.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will own strategic expansion planning for the RSR+ program, including evaluation, prioritization, and the development and maintenance of expansion roadmaps that guide the program's long-term growth trajectory. You will run the program's intake-to-launch lifecycle, moving initiatives from prioritized intake through scoping and tollgate reviews to launch. You will scope and drive expansion initiatives across a range of strategic programs, translating ambiguous opportunities into structured, executable plans.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will partner with Network Design to validate and align expansion priorities with network capacity and infrastructure realities. You will coordinate across cross-functional stakeholders — spanning design, selection, supply chain, capacity, operations, optimization, and quality — operating within a defined RACI to remove blockers and drive decisions that keep programs moving forward. Through data-driven decision making, you will synthesize complex, multi-source inputs into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations — communicating expansion strategy, risks, and program status to VP-level leadership through written and verbal business reviews. You will identify risks and interdependencies early and drive resolution across stakeholder groups.

A day in the life
Your day spans capacity feasibility analysis, driving programs through their decision gates, and building OP-level business cases that distill months of network-planning complexity into crisp, decision-ready briefs. Your stakeholders span Network Design, Selection, Supply Chain, and Capacity — and every day is about connecting dots, driving clarity, and moving expansion decisions forward.

About the team
The RSR+ (Rural Super Rural) program is on a mission to bring delivery speed parity to rural and super rural customers across the country. We operate as a fulfillment center (FC) model within last-mile delivery — meaning we don't just plan strategy, we build and run real operations. Our team sits at the intersection of strategic planning and operational execution, and we value systems thinking, data-driven approaches, and collaborative problem-solving. You'll have real scope and real visibility from day one.

OpenAI's Vendor Security team helps internal teams work securely with external products, services, and partners. About the Role

We are looking for a Vendor Security Technical Program Manager who can make sound security decisions and turn recurring vendor-security problems into tools and practices that work.

You will independently lead vendor-security engagements: understand the business need, investigate the actual data and access, recommend a practical path, and work with the responsible owners until the safeguards are verified. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who combines technical judgment with useful delivery. Make assessment decisions independently and use judgment about when to involve peers, specialists, or leadership. Route formal exceptions and risk acceptance to the appropriate decision owners.

- Understand vendor use cases, workflows, user journeys, data flows, identities, access, integrations, and supply-chain dependencies. Identify plausible attack paths and their consequences for OpenAI.

- Assess relevant architectures, configurations, controls, logs, and operational practices. Test whether the evidence supports the security claims that matter to the engagement, and make gaps and uncertainty clear.

- Develop practical treatments, including changes to the operating model, data exposure, access, architecture, vendor choice, controls, or containment. Drive implementation with the responsible owners and verify that the treatment works.

- Know relevant frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, and SOC 2, and can use them to inform an assessment of the actual engagement.

jobs.description: Are you excited about building the marketing engine for a new business from the ground up? We are looking for a Marketing Manager to own and drive growth for the Ring Appstore. This is not a traditional marketing role — you will run the full marketing motion for a business that connects hardware, software, and third-party integrations, taking responsibility for strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration. You will own marketing for two distinct customer segments: third-party developers who build apps for Ring, and Ring customers who subscribe and use 3P apps. Your mission: accelerate Ring Appstore growth by driving awareness, acquisition, engagement, and retention across Ring customers and third-party app developers. Key job responsibilities - Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Ring Appstore, defining targeting, channel mix, creative messaging, and A/B testing to drive awareness through conversion and retention. - Design, launch, and optimize multi-channel campaigns including email, in-app, push, paid media, and Ring ecosystem cross-promotion, while analyzing performance metrics to continuously improve results. - Develop go-to-market plans for new app launches and partner programs, collaborating with product, engineering, developer relations, and business development teams to align on priorities. - Build co-marketing playbooks that empower third-party developers to promote their apps, and regularly review data to identify growth opportunities and experiment with new marketing motions. - Contribute to cadenced reporting and business reviews, translating funnel data into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership. A day in the life You will run the marketing motion for a new and growing business. On a given day you might review campaign performance data before joining a cross-functional sync with product and developer relations partners, then shift to drafting messaging for an upcoming app launch. You will regularly meet with customers (Ring customers who use apps, and Developers who build apps) to understand their needs, work across internal teams to remove blockers, and experiment with new growth motions. This role gives you the chance to run a full-stack marketing program for an innovative business that connects hardware, software, and integrations. About the team Ring Appstore is a third-party application marketplace for Ring cameras and devices. It enables developers to build, certify, and distribute apps that extend Ring's capabilities, from professional monitoring services to smart lighting integrations and beyond. The business is in a growth stage with an expanding app catalog, accelerating user adoption, and a maturing developer pipeline. We are building Ring Appstore to become the hub where Ring customers discover value-added services and where developers find a thriving market for smart home innovation.
